Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 x_count number := 0;
 temp_record VARCHAR2(1);
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 --
 -- If only one reason exist and user selected it, then
 -- allow user to restock the product. Else, if more
 -- than one reason exist, then remove reason(s) that
 -- a user has selected.
 --
 if :s_reason_count = 1
 then
 if :s_select_flag is null
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 else
 if :GLOBAL.product_expire = 'Y'
 then
 :s_restock := 'N';
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('S_RESTOCK',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_RESTOCK', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE );
 GO_ITEM('reject_code');
 elsif :GLOBAL.product_expire = 'N'
 then
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('S_RESTOCK',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_RESTOCK', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 GO_ITEM('s_restock');
 end if;
 end if;
 else
 temp_record := :system.trigger_record;
 first_record;
 begin
 loop
 if :s_select_flag = 'X'
 then
 x_count := x_count + 1;
 end if;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 end loop;
 end;
 go_record(temp_record);
 if x_count = :s_reason_count
 then
 execute_trigger('key-commit');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 execute_trigger('key-down');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 message('x_count ' || to_char(x_count));
end;

begin
 if :s_reason_count = 1
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_restock');
 else
 :system.message_level := 5;
 check_x(xs_count);
 if xs_count = :s_reason_count
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_restock');
 else
 commit;
 if form_success
 then
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 :s_reason_count := 0;
 get_quarantine_reason;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error_dist('0230'); -- unsuccessful commit .. transaction
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end if;
end;

procedure check_for_interdictions(p_unit_id in VARCHAR2,
 p_coll_date in date,
 p_product_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_aliquot in varchar2) is
 temp_count number;
 temp_label_dats date;
begin
 begin
 select nvl(label_dats,sysdate-1000000)
 into temp_label_dats
 from components
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and component_prefix = p_aliquot;
 end;
 --
 -- Check if unit has interdictions
 --
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from unit_interdictions ui, valid_interdictions_lab vi
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = p_unit_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and ui.inter_code = vi.inter_code
 and vi.inter_type != 'I'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 and insert_dats > temp_label_dats;
 if temp_count > 0
 then
 show_error_dist('3722'); -- unit interdicted
 check_package_failure;

 end;
 if p_product_code is not null
 then
 begin

 and product_code = p_product_code

 null;

 check_package_failure;

 from component_interdictions

 and unit_id = p_unit_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date

 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed

 show_error_dist('0000');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit

 show_error_dist('0601');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026,0)

 declare

 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);

 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
